application.javascript:
const form=document.getElementById('booking-form');const dateInput=document.getElementById('date');const list=document.getElementById('booking-list');const empty=document.getElementById('empty-state');const error=document.getElementById('form-error');const confirmation=document.getElementById('confirmation');const count=document.getElementById('booking-count');const bookings=[];const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');const today=new Date();dateInput.min=`${today.getFullYear()}-${pad(today.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(today.getDate())}`;function displayDate(value){return new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString(undefined,{weekday:'short',month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'})}function displayTime(value){const [h,m]=value.split(':');const d=new Date();d.setHours(h,m);return d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined,{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'})}function render(){empty.hidden=bookings.length>0;count.textContent=bookings.filter(b=>!b.cancelled).length;list.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="booking"]').forEach(node=>node.remove());bookings.forEach((booking,index)=>{const article=document.createElement('article');article.className=`booking${booking.cancelled?' cancelled':''}`;article.dataset.testid='booking';article.dataset.status=booking.cancelled?'cancelled':'active';article.innerHTML=`

${booking.type}
${booking.cancelled?'Cancelled':'Confirmed'}
▣ ${displayDate(booking.date)}◷ ${displayTime(booking.time)}✉ ${booking.email}
${booking.cancelled?'':''}`;article.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-name-display"]').textContent=booking.name;if(!booking.cancelled)article.querySelector('[data-testid="booking-cancel"]').addEventListener('click',()=>{booking.cancelled=true;render()});list.appendChild(article)})}form.addEventListener('submit',event=>{event.preventDefault();error.textContent='';if(!form.checkValidity()){form.reportValidity();return}const data=new FormData(form);const selected=data.get('date');const chosen=new Date(`${selected}T00:00:00`);const now=new Date();now.setHours(0,0,0,0);if(chosen{confirmation.hidden=true},5000)});render();

tests.requirement: Include fields for customer name, email address, appointment date and appointment time.
Prevent a booking from being created when required information is missing.
Reject an email address that is not in a valid email format using browser-side validation.
Prevent a booking from being created for a date in the past.
After a valid booking is submitted, display the booking in a visible list or booking area.
Display a visible confirmation after a valid booking is successfully created.
Allow each booking to be cancelled. Cancellation may either remove the booking from the active list or clearly mark it as cancelled.
Keep booking data in page memory only. Refreshing or reopening the page must reset the booking data.
